What is still missing

Physical collapse or choice law — actual records are supplied openly.
Physical entropy production.
Elapsed duration and global simultaneity.
Gravity / Einstein correspondence.

We are not claiming to have explained time. A proposed route toward its emergence is now visible, testable, and explicit about what is still missing. Cube coordinates are illustrative, not physical space.
